description: Render Angular components to PDF in the browser: pdf-* elements, flexbox layout, paginated tables with repeating headers, page numbers and real selectable text.
rules: A document is a standalone Angular component that imports PDF_ELEMENTS and uses pdf-document > pdf-page in its template.
Render with inject(PdfRenderer).download(Component, { inputs, fileName }) or .toBlob(Component, { inputs }); outside an injection context use renderToBlob/downloadPdf with an injector.
Lengths without a unit are points; style with the static style attribute or [style.x] bindings, using the properties listed on the style-properties page.
Table columns are declared on pdf-table with [columns] (points, 'Nfr' or 'N%'); a pdf-row with the header attribute repeats on every page.
Only the 14 standard PDF fonts (WinAnsi) are supported in v0.1; characters outside WinAnsi become '?'.
